body.prompt: Wide dramatic shot inside a torch-lit Roman imperial tribunal hall in the frontier city of Sirmium, rough stone walls hung with dark red banners, a raised stone dais at the far end: in the centre of the floor an elderly Greek scholar of about seventy-three, long flowing white beard, thin white curly hair, gaunt hollow cheeks, red-rimmed grief-stricken eyes, white wool himation with a thin purple border over a pale tunic stands with his right arm stretched out, pointing furiously toward the dais, mouth open as if shouting; on the left a group of Athenian delegates in white togas recoil; along the walls Roman guards with tall shields; at the far end on the dais the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius at about fifty-four, short curly grey-brown hair, short grey-flecked beard, lean weathered face, plain brown wool tunic under a deep crimson military cloak sits very still on a curule chair, small in the distance, his face in shadow. Tense frozen moment, torch smoke in the air. Cinematic oil-painting look, like a dark Renaissance chiaroscuro painting brought to life, deep warm shadows, a single warm candle or torch light source, muted bronze, umber and deep navy palette, fine film grain, painterly texture, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no logos, no watermark anywhere.
